rationale: EO 10534 (19 FR 3413) put the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation under the direction and supervision of the Secretary of Defense. EO 10771 (1958-06-20) restated it to read as follows (Defense supervision limited to construction, Commerce for the rest). Section 16 of EO 11382 (32 FR 16247, signed 1967-11-28) states that the following are revoked: (1) Executive Order No. 10534 of June 9, 1954, and also revokes EO 10771. The revocation is express and whole-order, so the order had no force on 2026-10-14. The first-end date of the original command is not claimed here: whether Defense supervision lapsed earlier on completion of construction is not shown by a held source. Recommended status: no.
